explain.text: $\mathbf{w}^T\boldsymbol{\Sigma}\mathbf{w} = 0.25(0.09) + 0.25(0.0225) + 2(0.25)(-0.009)$, which is $0.023625$. Its square root is 0.1537, so 15.37%. The negative correlation pulls it well below the 22.5% average.
